title: Migrate @earendil-works/pi-durable -> @oh-my-pi/pi-durable (chep code, doi scope)
one_line: Chep nguyen 63 file / 807,033 byte cua packages/durable (durable conversation + task + document runtime) vao packages/durable, doi 78 lan @earendil-works/ -> @oh-my-pi/, giai quyet 11 va cham voi code omp da co truoc do khi moi chay duoc.
why_copy_not_reimplement: CHENH LECH SO LUONG: 63 file / 807,033 byte / 9,024 dong src, trong do 1520 dong (src/testing/storage-conformance.ts) chi la bo kiem chung dung chung cho 3 back-end storage, va 114 KB docs/pico-v5.md la dac ta normative 2,400 dong. Bat buoc bao tri tu la 4 invariant cua giao dich (commit nguyen tuyet doi; chi cong bo document sau khi commit thanh cong; moi tien do nhin thay deu ben vung; khong co duong cong bo bay loi) xung quanh 1,231 dong ma may - de lai nghiem thuc se ngay lap tuc sinh loi tiep canh ma khong co test nao bat. KHI SU TAI SUA: pi-ref la 1 commit squash (git log --oneline | wc -1 = 1, 1,935 file), nen KHONG co diff nao de 'cap nhat' - chi co copy. GIA TRI CONG: durable KHONG phai ban sao cua phien ban cua omp. pi-ref packages/agent/ co 117 file src, omp packages/agent/ chi 50, va CHI 5 ten file trung nhau - agent-loop.ts 26KB (pi) vs 148KB (omp), agent.ts 19KB vs 74KB, types.ts 19KB vs 51KB. durable la suc tach ra TICH LUY TRONG PI sau khi omp da phat trien tiep: ba noi gop 3 thu, tong 20KB source, va no cham truc tiep vao mot trong nhung thu omp da manh nhat. KHONG TOI THIEU: he thong nay da duoc dung THAT truoc khi tach (Server, pi-protocol, pi-evals deu import no). No la mot persistence runtime da kiem chung, khong phai mot ban thiet ke. CHUP KY CHON LUC: 3 adapter storage (Memory/Jsonl/Sqlite) cung mot bo 1520 dong test, dung nguyen ve nghiep nang, thi dua sang noi khac se ton that hon muc loi ghi lai.

test_contract:
HOP DONG QUAN SAT DUOC, 5 nhom, moi nhom mot test that tai chuc nang quan sat duoc - khong test 'code chay duoc':
(1) COMMIT NGUYEN TUUYET DOI. Commit mot Session, tat ca ghi vao Memory/Jsonl/Sqlite phai nhin thay mot commit. Bang bo 3 backend cung mot script la bang chung tot nhat - day la ca test goc cua storage-conformance.ts (1520 dong) va nen GIU NGUYEN VERBATIM.
(2) TAI. `ReadAfterWrite` nem khi doc sau ghi; `StorageRejected` lam Session van chay. Day la hai error class duy nhat.
(3) MIGRATION VAN BAN. document version N duoc doc voi definition version M<N va khong co `migrate` -> throw; co `migrate` -> gia tri da migrate. Nhanh khong loi la thuong vong nhat cua moi chang schema.
(4) AS-OF / FORK. `snapshotAsOf` tai mot EntryId cu hon phai tra ve dung gia tri lich su, va fork mot conversation tai entry giua phai giu dung ancestry. Chi 'latest' thi khong duoc co asOf.
(5) SCOPE MISMATCH. Truy cap mot doc token 'session' vao ban ghi da luu co scope 'conversation' -> TypeError. La hanh vi doc sai nhat, va cung la noi 2 va cham Context/Scope se lo hong.
CHAM DIEM RIENG - ENV. truncate: cat 2500 dong, ca 3000 (omp) va 2000 (durable) deu phai ra ket qua DUNG; dau la 'lines' hay 'bytes' la observable. output-capture: emit byte-rate + adaptive publisher phai boc duoc trong khi luong dat gioi han.

documents_ts.noi_dung:
M1 goi day la 'nua document' va tu thanh la diem khong co bang chung duy nhat trong milestone. DOC LA KY: no KHONG phai mot phan document. No la LOP PHAI - noi doc cac Dinh nghia (definitions) thanh dia chi luu (address) va kiem tra chung (validation). Ha tang that su - Session, Transaction, va ca 3 storage backend - deu goi qua no. Khong co no thi khong co gi chay duoc.

BA KHA NANG CU THE:
1. PHAN GIAI DA NANG (tu 2 overload thanh 1). `defineDoc` va `defineDocFamily` co 4 overload moi: scope 'session', scope 'conversation' + history 'latest', scope 'conversation' + history 'rewindable', scope 'task'. Kieu tr ve khac nhau (SessionDocToken / ConversationDocToken / RewindableConversationDocToken / TaskDocToken). Nghe doi la `tx.doc(MyToken)` se KHONG bi chay khi token va ban ghi da luu lech scope - do la dinh nghia tai thoi gian bien dich, khong phai kiem tra runtime.
2. DIA CHI LUON ON DINH. `resolveAddress` bien danh sach tham so thanh mot `DocumentAddress` (kind + scope + key), roi `addressId` bien no thanh chuoi JSON dinh dang `[[kind, scopeKind, owner, key]]` lam KEY cua Map. Hai thu doan nay la thu gi Session giu trong `#documents`. Hieu qua: mot tai lieu tai MOT dia chi logic nao do co DUNG MOT the he chuoi, nen duoc tra ve nhanh, va MOT dia chi co the BIO TAI LAI nhieu lan (mo moi lai cua so voi ID moi).
3. MIGRATION CO GA. `checkRecordVersion` nem neu ban ghi moi hon definition, va nem them neu ban ghi CUU hon ma definition khong co `migrate`. `materializeDocument` chay `migrate(value, fromVersion)` roi copy lai. Day la noi chang schema an toan xay ra, va la thu nguyen duy nhat quyet dinh ban ghi cu co dung duoc hay khong.
documents_ts.nguoi_dung_thay_gi:
1. KHONG BAO GIO MAT LICH SU KHI NGAT MAY. Mot tai lieu co ban ghi hien tai + ban ghi da retired (`createdAt`/`retiredAt` bang Seq cua tung commit). Doc lai `DocumentPoint = Seq | 'current'` - ban co the mo bang 'trang thai tai commit so N'. Day la ca hai chu 'durable' va 'rewindable' ghep lai.
2. FORK MOT CUOC CHOI NHEO, TAI MOT CAU THOI GIAN BAT KY. `fork: 'asOf'` + `snapshotAsOf(token, conversationId, entryId)` tra ve TAI LIEU TAI MOT `EntryId` bat ky trong quau he, khong phai tai luc ban tao fork. Nghia la: quay lai va xem '15 phut truoc, bo qua nhung gi toi vua sua, agent dang lam gi' - mot tinh nang ma phan lon he thong agent khong co. Tinh nang nay chi co neu tai lieu CHI LUU 'latest'.
3. TAI LIEU CO CHAP LUONG VA GIAI HAN THEO PHAM VI. Mot tai lieu gan voi mot `TaskId` hay mot `ConversationId` se bi `retireDoc` dong lai khi pham vi do ket thuc - ban khong phai don dep thu cong.
4. KHU VUC DEMO CHO NGUOI DUNG: MOT `todo` hay mot `notes` cua phien chat, sua duoc giu nguyen khi may bi kill, va doc lai duoc o bat ky commit nao. Khong dung de giu rat nhieu thu it quan trong.
